primaryTextRead.text: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z — Mishmannah
wikipediaRead.locator: L–Z人物一覧「Mishmannah」節（613–617行）は、1CH12:10の人物をツィクラグに集まったガド人の一人と明記。
